risk_if_not_implemented: Without Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training, personnel are more likely to make unsafe decisions, fall victim to social engineering, mishandle data or violate requirements. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Lack of a security-minded workforce (R-SA-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Publishing Security, Compliance & Resilience Documentation
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to establish, maintain and disseminate policies, standards and procedures necessary for secure, compliant and resilient capabilities.
compensating_control_1.justification: Publishing Security, Compliance & Resilience Documentation (GOV-04) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training (SAT-04) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to provide role-based security, compliance and resilience-related training: 
(1) Before authorizing access to the system or performing assigned duties; 
(2) When required by system changes; and 
(3) Annually thereafter.
compensating_control_2.justification: Role-Based Security, Compliance & Resilience Training (SAT-05) provides personnel training and awareness that compensates for the absence of Security, Compliance & Resilience Awareness Training (SAT-04) by reducing human-factor risk by equipping personnel to recognize and respond to relevant threats. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
